subject: Re: Crescent Health SIG / SCIM + SAML artifact curation
messages:
From: Alejandra Ruiz <security@crescenthealth.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: soc@crescenthealth.com
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Crescent Health SIG follow-up: SCIM delta + SSO assertion samples

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the call this morning — Crescent is close to closing out our SIG assessment and we need a compact evidence bundle for SCIM/SAML. Specifically we need: 1) a CSV of a recent SCIM delta showing create/update/delete events for a 30-day window, 2) representative SAML assertion samples (email + groups), and 3) an access owner snapshot for the primary org (resource owners + justification).

Can you drop a short zip with those artifacts by EOD Monday PST? If you have any redactions guidance for PII in SCIM samples, let us know.

Appreciate it,
Alejandra
Alejandra Ruiz
Information Security Lead, Crescent Health
[Attachment: SIG-RFI-Checklist.pdf (PDF)]

From: priyom_das@redwood.com <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alejandra Ruiz <security@crescenthealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Crescent Health SIG follow-up: SCIM delta + SSO assertion samples

Hi Alejandra — thanks, we can get that to you. Quick notes: 1) SCIM delta: we can export the raw delta CSV, but we redact personal email addresses to hashed tokens and include an ID mapping file (ID -> hashed token) for traceability; 2) SAML assertions: we'll include 3 anonymized assertions (login, group claim, service-account-style assertion) with timestamps + original Issuer/ACS metadata; 3) access owner snapshot: we will provide an XLSX with owners, role names, last activity, and a short justification column for any privileged roles.

Plan: Kimberly will pull the SCIM delta and owner snapshot; Sean will prepare the SAML assertion samples and a short README describing how to validate the assertion signatures. We expect to upload a zip to the Drive link and share a signed URL.

Target: drop files Monday 1800 PST / Tue 0200 UTC. If Crescent needs raw email addresses for a legal review we can discuss a secure delivery process.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Security & Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-scim-redaction-policy.txt (TXT)]
